oauth-missing-provider.en: No OAuth provider was specified in local storage. Please start the login process again.
oauth-missing-provider.zh: 本地未保存第三方登录服务信息，请重新发起登录。

oauth-provider-mismatch.en: The OAuth provider does not match the one saved locally. Please start the login process again.
oauth-provider-mismatch.zh: 第三方登录服务与本地保存的信息不一致，请重新发起登录。

email-verification-thanks.en: Thank you, your email was verified. Enjoy using wanderer!
email-verification-thanks.zh: 感谢验证，您的邮箱已验证成功。祝您使用 wanderer 愉快！

profile-cached-data.en: could not be fetched from the remote server. Showing cached data.
profile-cached-data.zh: 暂时无法从远程服务器获取资料，当前显示缓存数据。

import-illustration.en: A wanderer walking into the distance
import-illustration.zh: 徒步者走向远方的插图

error-adding-trail-to-list.zh: 将路线添加到列表失败。

plugin-oauth-invalid-callback.en: The authorization callback is invalid or expired. Please connect the plugin again.
plugin-oauth-invalid-callback.zh: 授权回调无效或已过期，请重新连接插件。

route-service-not-configured.en: The routing service is not configured. Contact the server administrator.
route-service-not-configured.zh: 路线规划服务尚未配置，请联系服务器管理员。

route-service-unavailable.en: The routing service could not be reached. Please try again later.
route-service-unavailable.zh: 暂时无法连接路线规划服务，请稍后重试。
